title: Montenegro preparing first renewable energy auctions to accelerate green transition

topic_justification: Related topic: quoted claim is quota, ceiling price and contract length.

topic_justification: Related topic: the quoted claim is the ceiling price and CfD structure.
title: Montenegro sets ceiling price of €65/MWh for first solar auction
claim: International trade press repeats the 250 MW / €65/MWh / 12-year CfD terms and a 20% quota-extension clause.

title: EBRD supports first renewable energy auction in Montenegro

quote: For the first time, we are introducing a market-based, fair and transparent support system for renewable energy projects.

topic_justification: Canonical topic: the claim is new investment inflows from the auction.
title: Šahmanović: Launching the auction process will open the door to hundreds of millions of euros of new investments

quote: The first such auction in Montenegro will be held for “unspecified locations,” which means that the planned photovoltaic systems can be located in any area in the country.

title: Montenegro sets November 10 deadline for first solar power auction
claim: Public call: bids by 10 November 2025, 250 MW, ≥400 kW projects, location-neutral, €65/MWh ceiling, 12-year CfD, grid-related bank guarantees of €20 or €40 per kW.

quote: This is a plan that enables new investments, new renewable energy power plants, modern grid infrastructure, and a secure transition for the Pljevlja coal region.

topic_justification: Canonical topic: quoted claim names a secure transition for the Pljevlja coal region (grid is mentioned in passing).
title: Montenegro adopts National Energy and Climate Plan
claim: Government adopted the NECP on 10 December 2025 (55% emissions cut, ≥50% renewables) alongside a cross-border electricity/gas bill.

quote: This is a plan that enables new investments, new RES power plants, modern grid infrastructure and a secure transition for Pljevlja.
tone_justification: Repeats the ministry’s enabling-investment / Pljevlja-transition framing without a critical counter-quote.
topic_justification: Canonical topic: Pljevlja transition is in the quoted sentence alongside RES investment.
title: Montenegro adopted the National Energy and Climate Plan
claim: Ministry quoted: NECP plus the cross-border exchange law are the key European-obligation documents of the previous eight months.

quote: At the end of last year, the Ministry of Energy canceled the tender… because none of the bids met the conditions prescribed by law and the public invitation, including the submission of evidence older than the prescribed deadlines, failure to meet the requirements related to spatial planning documentation and qualification requirements for connection to the electricity system.

topic_justification: Canonical topic: quoted failures are deadlines, spatial-planning documents and grid-connection qualifications (grid is the secondary cue).
title: Bidders did not meet tender conditions: Call for award of financial compensation for the construction of solar power plants canceled
claim: First auction cancelled; 11 firms bought documents, four bids submitted, none qualified. Three-year plan still listed 250 MW solar in Q1 2026 and 200 MW wind in Q3.

topic_justification: Canonical topic: quoted shortcomings are participation/qualification conditions, including planning documents.
title: Montenegro to renew first solar power auction call as soon as possible

title: Montenegro’s cancelled solar auction and the reset of its renewable energy strategy
claim: Commentary: four bids disqualified; barriers cited include land-use permitting, grid-connection uncertainty and balancing rules; a Q1 2026 relaunch was then planned.

title: Montenegro scraps first solar auction and prepares new renewables tender for 2026
claim: 11 companies bought documents, four bids, none qualified; 2026–2028 programme described as 250 MW solar + 200 MW wind under the RES Law.
